content:
Beside EM/Plasma propulsion UFOs could use other effects like Centrifugal, Coanda, Magnus effect and Boundary layer control to mimic levitation and hovering. #ufotwitter

Boundary layer suction / Boundary layer control

Air is sucked/pumped from the upper surface to thin or remove the boundary layer → reduces drag, increases lift, and improves aerodynamic efficiency. Often combined with rotating surfaces or impellers.

Magnus effect

Counter-rotating rings interact with airflow → creates pressure differences (low pressure on one side, high on the other) that generate lift, similar to how spinning cylinders or balls produce side force in fluid dynamics.

Coanda effect

Jet streams are directed to follow curved ("Coanda") surfaces → attaches airflow to the craft's body, creating additional lift and allowing thrust vectoring/control.

Centrifugal / Centripetal forces

Rotating surfaces or centrifugal fans create outward/centripetal air movement → thins boundary layer, expands jet streams, and contributes to lift or flow redirection.
